question_text: A museum has many departments. Each curator and each technician belongs to one department. A curator can work with several technicians, and a technician can work with several curators. Construct an ERD showing these three relationships and their cardinalities.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: DEPARTMENT 1—many CURATOR; DEPARTMENT 1—many TECHNICIAN; CURATOR many—many TECHNICIAN. A link entity may resolve the last relationship.

marking_points.criterion: Curator to technician is many-to-many, or correct link-entity resolution.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
